`RunCtx::append_and_fold` is the run's one-event case: it stamps the run id and appends through the run's folding store (`Deps::folding`), whose append delegates to `ingest::FoldingStore::append_and_fold`, the one append-then-fold body, rather than re-implementing it.
`shape` is the helper nested inside `check_fold_payload` that its match arms call; the scanner counts the nested body inside the outer function too, which is the only overlap.

The CLI suite seeds a two-subsystem coupling graph into the real on-disk store through the folding store's `append_and_fold`, while the fold suite folds a different single-hub graph straight onto an in-memory projector.
Two one-line accessors on two different types reading two different fields (the content-identity policy's metadata key versus the graph file a rebuild lock excludes).
